summary: Frontend-only verification of full Dashboard relayout (all-light editorial). Login with empty fields → /#dashboard. All required rv-* testids present and functional at 1920x1080 and 1280 widths. Segment tabs, KPI band, chart (ranges + CSV export + tooltip), segments/top accounts trio, and Account detail (search/expand/empty state) all work. NO console errors. ONE visual bug found: the gauge inside rv-goal-card renders only '%' and 'of goal' — the numeric '67' is not visible.

ui_bugs.issue: Numeric percent '67' is not rendered inside the SVG gauge. Only '%' and 'of goal' are visible in the gauge center. DOM textContent of .rv-gauge-num is '67%' but visually the '67' glyph is missing at all viewport widths.

action_items: Fix the '67' not rendering in Goal progress gauge. RCA: the source JSX at /app/frontend/src/DashboardPage.tsx:132 is `{pct}%`. At runtime the visual-editor instrumentation wraps the dynamic {pct} expression in an HTML `67` inside the SVG `` element. Browsers do NOT render HTML `` children of SVG `` (only `` is valid), so the number becomes invisible while the literal '%' after it still renders. Fix by wrapping the dynamic value in an SVG ``: `{pct}%`, OR replace the SVG text with an absolutely-positioned HTML overlay div showing `{pct}%`, OR precompute `const label = `${pct}%`` and place it as a static string so instrumentation does not inject a span child. Same pattern should be audited for any other JSX expressions embedded inside SVG ``.
critical_code_review_comments: SVG <text> children must be text nodes or <tspan>; never HTML <span>. Dev tooling that wraps dynamic JSX in <span> will silently break SVG text rendering (as observed for rv-gauge-num).
rv-gauge-cap 'of goal' renders fine because it is a static string — confirms the runtime instrumentation is the trigger.
